subject: SIG questionnaire: pen test artifact transfer & scope clarifications (Sapphire Tech)
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@sapphire-tech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@sapphire-tech.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire — pen test report and scope details

Hi Connor,

We're working through the vendor SIG for an upcoming client assessment and the questionnaire requires the latest penetration test report (or a redacted summary) plus a mapping that shows which sections of the report correspond to SIG questions (especially AppSec and Infrastructure controls). Can you confirm:

- Whether Redwood can provide a redacted pen test summary that is safe to post to our GRC portal?
- A brief scope statement (dates, external/internal, blackbox/whitebox, third‑party tester)?
- Current remediation status for any high/critical findings (CVE references or internal ticket ids)?

We prefer to receive artifacts via the GRC upload link below or SFTP. If you can upload, please include filenames and a short evidence manifest.

Portal link for uploads: https://grc.sapphire-tech.com/upload/record/7f3a2c

Thanks — aim is to close this vendor assessment by next week if possible.

Lindsey Park
Vendor Risk Manager
Sapphire Tech

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@sapphire-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — pen test report and scope details

Lindsey — thanks for the note and the portal link. We can provide a redacted pen test summary and a remediation manifest. A couple quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what you need:

1) Redaction level: do you need the full report redacted (technical exploit traces removed) or is a 2–3 page executive summary that maps findings to SIG/CAIQ controls sufficient for your reviewers?
2) Scope confirmation: our most recent assessment (Feb 18–20, 2027) was an external black‑box engagement covering the public API endpoints and customer‑facing web console. The test was conducted by NightGuard Security (third‑party). Does that align with the scope Sapphire expects to see?
3) Format & upload: we'll prepare a PDF summary plus an XLS remediation tracker. Do you prefer the files named with a specific convention (e.g., orgname-pt-redacted-YYYYMMDD)? Also does the portal require a manifest file or a short README?

I'll loop Marissa for the remediation details and Neha for the upload. We can aim to get the artifacts into your portal within 48 hours once we confirm redaction level.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555‑0193

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@sapphire-tech.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — pen test report and scope details

Hi Lindsey — internal security here. Per Connor's note, attached is a redacted summary and our remediation tracker. Key points: 

- Assessment: NightGuard Security, external black‑box, engagement window 2027‑02‑18 to 2027‑02‑20.
- Redaction: we removed exploit POCs and any identifying customer data; the PDF is suitable for GRC consumption.
- High/Critical items: 1 critical (fixed on 2027‑03‑10, CVE‑2027‑0845, deploy id: DEP‑1187), 2 high (one fixed, one pending validation), a list of medium/low items in the tracker.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: we included a one‑sheet mapping in the Drive link (controls covered: VI‑1, VI‑2, SI‑2 equivalents in the SIG template).

Attachments (uploaded to our shared Drive and attached for portal upload):
- redacted-pt-summary-sapphire-2027.pdf (PDF, 42 pages reduced to a 6‑page redacted summary)
- remediation-tracker-sapphire-2027.xlsx (Excel, status + ticket ids + validation notes)

Notes on evidence: for the fixed critical item we can provide a sanitized patch diff and a deployment timestamp; for the pending validation we can provide the Jira ticket SUP‑342 and current test plan. If Sapphire needs live verification (retest), we can schedule a short follow‑up engagement with NightGuard (estimate 1–2 days).

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Red Team Liaison
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@sapphire-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — pen test report and scope details

Thanks Marissa — this is exactly what we need. Two quick follow ups: 

1) For the pending validation (SUP‑342), can you include the last successful smoke test logs (sanitized) or a short note from NightGuard confirming the planned retest steps?
2) Upload preference: please use the GRC portal link I sent. If you hit any file size limits, SFTP is OK — we will accept either.

I'll mark the vendor assessment as "documentation received" when the artifacts are in the portal; final acceptance will be after we review the remediation tracker and the SUP‑342 test evidence.

Lindsey Park
Vendor Risk Manager
Sapphire Tech

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@sapphire-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — pen test report and scope details

Lindsey — we've uploaded the two files to the portal and added a small README linking the SUP‑342 Jira ticket and the sanitized smoke test excerpt per your request. Drive link is included in the portal entry and also below.

Portal upload summary:
- Upload time: 2027‑04‑06T14:00:00‑07:00
- Files: redacted-pt-summary-sapphire-2027.pdf, remediation-tracker-sapphire-2027.xlsx, readme-sapphire-upload.txt
- Supplemental evidence: sanitized_smoketest_excerpt.txt, SUP‑342 (Jira: https://jira.redwood-inference.com/browse/SUP-342)

If you need additional artifacts or would like NightGuard to perform the retest, loop me in and we'll schedule. Otherwise expect the assessment to be marked complete once you confirm the tracker validation.
